sites.name: Star Tech
sites.note: Samsung/Xiaomi/OnePlus/Honor tablets are official stock (official); iPads carry '1 Year international warranty' (unofficial). Single-config pages, connectivity and RAM/storage read from the spec table. Used as specsSource.

sites.name: Gadget & Gear
sites.note: Authorised reseller (official). One page per config; cash price = discountedPrice in page data, regular price recorded as oldPrice. Most older iPad configs (10th gen, Air M2/M3, Pro M4) show Stock Out with price.

sites.name: Apple Gadgets
sites.note: Unofficial imports unless the URL ends in '-official'; per-variant price/compare price/status. Keyboard/book-cover bundles and nano-texture iPad options excluded; implausible variant prices (e.g. 512GB cellular below 256GB) skipped.

sites.name: Sumash Tech
sites.note: Separate '-official' pages (official) and international pages (unofficial); per-variant price, discount and stock. 10,000 placeholder prices on some cellular iPad options skipped.

sites.name: Kry International
sites.note: Unofficial pages (region per variant when given) plus '-official' pages. Some official tablet pages carry placeholder prices (1,600-8,600) and were skipped.

sites.name: Executive Machines
sites.note: Apple Authorised Reseller, one page per config, official warranty.

sites.name: Diamu
sites.note: WooCommerce, unofficial; per-variant prices. Several older tablet pages return no price and were skipped.

sites.name: Dazzle
sites.note: Unofficial imports; variants in page data (found via the tablet category pages, not in the product sitemap). MRP shown is inflated. Pages without a network option where the model has both Wi-Fi and 5G versions were skipped; placeholder-priced options skipped.

sites.name: Mobile Buzz BD
sites.note: WooCommerce; per-option price and stock, unofficial unless the option says official. Pages whose only price is 0 (variations not in page data) and 10,000 placeholder options skipped.

sites.name: CustomMacBD
sites.note: Shopify, unofficial imports; options split by warranty claim support (paid/free) — the paid-claim (cheaper) option is used.

sites.name: HNS Tech
sites.note: Unofficial; per-variant price and stock in the page's data-variants JSON.

sites.name: PCB Store
sites.note: Importer channel, treated unofficial; one config per page.
